assumptions: Unit price is GBP (the source describes a UK-registered retailer; there is no currency column).
Credit notes (invoice prefix C) are refunds; matched LIFO to earlier sales of the same customer and SKU.
Exact duplicate rows are removed (count published); some may be genuine repeated scans.
Product families are DERIVED from description keywords; the source has no category.
Newsvendor cost, salvage and review period are assumptions (SIMULATED).
CLV is revenue, discounted at an assumed 10% a year, not profit.
disclaimers: Online Retail II, Daqing Chen (2012), UCI Machine Learning Repository, https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D, licensed CC BY 4.0. Derived aggregates, modified; not the original file.
Customers are anonymised integer keys; the source Customer IDs are never published.
Not representative of retail in general: one UK gift-ware wholesaler, 24 months, two Christmas seasons.
Analytical examples only, not business advice.

engine.star_schema: dbt-duckdb (models in dbt/): stg_raw, stg_lines, dim_product, dim_customer, dim_date, dim_country, fact_lines, fact_refund_match

no_demographics: The source contains no demographic fields. None are inferred, imputed or invented.

source.attribution: Online Retail II, Daqing Chen (2012), UCI Machine Learning Repository, https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D, licensed CC BY 4.0. Derived aggregates, modified; not the original file.
source.role: Sole data source: every invoice line of a UK online gift-ware wholesaler, 2009-12-01 to 2011-12-09.
